test_verdicts.rationale: The probability-unit marginal statistic, legal fixed-cardinality generator, and independent null calibration are internally consistent.
The selected standardized zone and reported original-unit structure effect remain bound to the same winning component.
Pair co-inclusion uses the exact without-replacement null and legal conditional alternatives with scalar-vector equality tests.
Calendar order and issue identities are preserved, with each sample size using its own registered temporal midpoint.
Cross-zone dependence uses frozen bins, bias-corrected Cramer's V, legal coupled tickets, and deterministic calibration.
Issue parity remains a reported diagnostic outside the ten-primary Holm family and cannot become candidate evidence.
Calendar trimming preserves the selected component and requires a nonzero direction-consistent sensitivity result.

effect_parameter_verdicts.rationale: The DLT marginal effect has frozen probability units, a complete grid, a practical boundary, and a legal generator.
The DLT structure effect uses a complete mean-sum grid and a legal mixture calibrated to the requested shift.
The DLT pair effect uses a complete probability grid and legal conditional target-pair tickets.
The DLT temporal effect has valid early-late probabilities and a frozen per-sample estimand policy.
The DLT cross-zone effect has a complete Cramer's V grid and separately seeded calibration.
The SSQ marginal effect has complete probability-unit coverage and a legal fixed-cardinality generator.
The SSQ structure effect remains tied to the reproducible standardized-statistic winning zone.
The SSQ pair effect maps to legal target-pair co-inclusion across the complete frozen grid.
The SSQ temporal effect preserves real calendar labels through n=200 and labels prospective identities above it.
The SSQ cross-zone effect has an executable legal coupling mechanism and complete calibrated grid.

method_verdicts.rationale: Qualification, audit, power, and replay share the same frozen draw loader and draw_date_local contract.
The explicit joint null and Holm adjustment cover exactly ten primary game-family decisions.
All registered alternatives emit legal tickets and bind generator parameters to stated effect estimands.
Reference, evaluation, interval, and replay corpora use frozen and domain-separated seed identities.
All 240 registered effect-by-sample-size points receive simultaneous bands and explicit required-n states.
Checkpoint identities bind configuration and batch hashes, rejecting missing, duplicated, altered, or stale batches.
Run results identify their requests, match request inputs, and reverse-bind selected published outputs.
Receipt identities are recursively rehashed and aggregate outcomes are traced to validated run results.
All 30 unique registered metrics map to at least one contract gate and inherit that gate's relevant deliverable and E2E evidence.
G0 and G1 require exactly eight frozen input identities plus exact values for all six registered entry checks.
Final acceptance explicitly schema-validates clean D2-05 and replay review, and requires PASS for canonical D2-07 through D2-10 artifacts.
Isolated E2E01 is pending only before its test accept and is synthesized exactly once for effective G6 and COV-07 evidence.
CAL-04 counts only negative controls promoted to candidate_signal; raw negative-control rejection remains reported and contributes to CAL-01.
Deliverable paths, run selections, registry rows, gate evidence, and metric evidence are explicitly reverse-validated.
D2-12 avoids self-hashing, while D2-13 records the frozen manifest identity and is not required to hash itself.
The final 32-file source-schema bundle recomputes exactly to the frozen environment-lock SHA-256 identity.
Phase 2 remains randomness diagnostics and power research, excluding prediction, betting recommendations, and certainty claims.
